        import pandas as pd
        import numpy as np
    
        simulation_data = pd.read_csv('/root/simulation_results.csv')
        sensor_data = pd.read_csv('/root/sensor_data.csv')
    
        merged = simulation_data.merge(sensor_data, on='time', suffixes=('_sim', '_sensor'))
